changes: Replace top-k output projection descriptor estimates with the shared scoped vectorProjectBatch contract.
Use admitted read-column collection in row projection, ordered row collection, sort runs and columnar top-k.
Keep read planning in child scopes so returned owner handles do not retain temporary column lists.
Share one column visitor between scoped and legacy callers, eliminating Object.values allocation in this helper.

coverage: Borrowed/owned columnar and deferred top-k boundary tests
Row projection admission and spill lifetime tests

remaining: Legacy callers of the optional-scope helper, including other projected scan/planning routes, still need scope integration.
Physical metadata, vector wrappers and runtime scratch remain separate audit items.
No whole-Worker memory guarantee is inferred from these library accounting changes.
